categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, design, development, production, sales, and service of smart electric sofas, smart electric beds, and their core accessories. It focuses on creating a highly integrated and user-friendly smart home product system within the furniture manufacturing industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in smart electric furniture, including adaptive adjustment mechanisms, surround sound integrated sofas, wireless remote controls, massage functions, and AI-based snoring intervention controllers. Manufacturing emphasizes high-quality production processes, quality control systems, and continuous innovation in product functionality and comfort.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's main customers are retail furniture clients in the United States, accounting for over 90% of sales. It serves primarily the North American market, with a strong presence in the US retail sector, including top 100 US furniture retailers, and expanding into Canada.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, Vietnam, and the United States, with production facilities in Vietnam and sales and retail operations in the US and Canada. It has established a broad retail network across 32 US states and 3 Canadian provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the furniture supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and direct sales to retail customers. It also manages international logistics and supply chain coordination, particularly for exports to North America.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the proprietary brand MotoMotion, expanding direct retail channels, and enhancing R&D capabilities with a focus on smart furniture innovation such as adaptive electric sofas, immersive audio systems, and smart beds with safety features. The company also emphasizes global supply chain optimization and local market delivery capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of smart electric sofas, beds, and accessories to retail customers, predominantly in the US market. The company operates a direct sales model with a growing number of retail partners and shop-in-shop brand display areas.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading smart furniture manufacturer with a strong brand presence in the US market, competing with global furniture suppliers including Vietnam-based exporters. It leverages innovation and brand recognition to differentiate itself in the mid-to-high-end smart furniture segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved RMB 2.55 billion in revenue, a 32.63% increase year-over-year, and a net profit of RMB 683 million, up 67.64%. It maintains a healthy gross margin of 39.35% and has shown consistent growth in sales volume and production capacity, with expanding international operations and retail footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes highly integrated smart home furniture products that combine comfort, advanced technology, and user-friendly features. Its unique value lies in innovative product designs such as adaptive adjustment, immersive audio integration, wireless controls, and health-related smart functions, supported by strong brand reputation and customer trust in the US retail market.
